At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce.

As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results.

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.
We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes.

Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

You have real sales skills and know how to close. This is a closing seat, and closing ability is the number one thing.
You have inside sales, phone sales, or SDR experience, with a real track record on the phone.
You handle objections on your own and ask for the sale, without sounding pushy or robotic.
You stay calm under pressure: when a customer pushes back or gets frustrated, you hear them out and respond thoughtfully instead of getting flustered or talking over them.
You communicate in confident, professional English at C2 level with a low accent, and sound natural on the phone.
You respond and follow through without anyone watching.
You keep the CRM clean and never let a follow-up slip.
You are the voice that turns warm customers into booked jobs. The demand is already there: customers call, the field team visits, and revenue gets left on the table when nobody follows up to close. This is not a cold-sales grind. You work from proven scripts, but you make them your own and sound human rather than robotic. You win the deal by handling objections live and guiding customers to yes.

Call customers and close deals, whether the opportunity is a service job or a larger project.
Handle objections live on the call and guide the customer to a yes rather than reading from a script.
Take the company's scripts, learn from them, and make them sound natural, never robotic.
Follow up with customers after each visit, capture honest feedback, and turn warm conversations into booked work.
Update the CRM (ServiceTitan) in real time with accurate records on every contact.

Experience in plumbing or construction, or a track record closing service and installation projects.
Formal sales training or coaching, with frameworks for discovery and closing.
Hands-on experience with ServiceTitan or a similar CRM.
Previous experience in a high-volume, phone-based, customer-facing role.
What success looks like
First 90 days: you are contacting customers and closing deals, ramped on scripts, and maintaining clean CRM hygiene.
Ongoing: you sustain a strong close rate month over month, meet conversion targets, and proactively surface and fix friction in the sales process.
Here is what to expect after you apply
You will get an email from Puente with a short online assessment and a quick grammar check.
You will record three short video answers so we can see how you communicate.
If it looks like a fit, our recruiter sets up an interview.
Shortlisted candidates are introduced to the US client team for final interviews.

You will also serve as a role model and mentor to newer SDRs, sharing best practices and helping elevate overall team performance.

Generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting across assigned EMEA territories.
Conduct research and account mapping to identify key decision-makers, influencers, and buying committees within target organisations.
Build relationships with multiple stakeholders across prospective accounts to increase account penetration and create new business opportunities.
Partner closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, progress opportunities, and drive pipeline growth.
Create and execute targeted outreach campaigns leveraging phone, email, social selling, and other prospecting channels.
Maintain accurate accounts, opportunities, and activity data within Salesforce and other sales engagement platforms.
Stay informed on EMEA market trends, competitive activity, and industry developments to enhance prospecting effectiveness and account strategies.
Consistently achieve or exceed pipeline generation, meeting creation, and activity targets.
Share best practices and provide guidance to less experienced SDR team members, contributing to overall team success.
Demonstrate a multithreading approach into large key accounts.
Outline using AI to streamline prospecting
Process and create efficiencies in workflow

Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively.
Experience using CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools such as Outreach, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar technologies.

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1st, 2026 you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Water division (Nalco Water, an Ecolab company), Ecolab delivers water treatment, process and digital water management solutions to help customers improve operational performance, protect critical assets and advance sustainability goals. Our solutions support customers across industrial, manufacturing, food and beverage processing, power generation, energy, mining, data-centers and commercial facilities, from water intake through reuse and discharge.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and technical advisor to your customers. You will provide expert guidance on water treatment, process optimisation and digital water management programs that help improve operational performance, protect critical assets and support safe, efficient and sustainable customer operations.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn how customers’ systems work, gaining hands-on experience with equipment, technologies and solutions used in their daily operations
Support the installation, maintenance and safe use of equipment, helping customers keep their facilities fully operational
Train and support customer teams, making sure they feel confident using Ecolab solutions
Gradually develop the ability to spot improvement opportunities, deliver technical demonstrations and support the growth of your assigned territory
Work closely with colleagues across different teams (Sales, Marketing Services, Customer Service) to deliver the best possible customer experience
Contribute to Ecolab’s growth by supporting outreach activities and helping build our brand in your local market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:
Have completed technical / scientific education (Ideally in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry)
Are interested in building a career in technical, sales or service-related roles
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have basic IT skills (Microsoft Office)
Have at least a B1 level in English
Hold a valid driver’s license, with an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record, and are open to traveling within your assigned district and occasionally nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12month fixed-term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business needs
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday
4% Flexible Benefits Allowance. A wide range of benefits (extended to families) or to be used as salary increase
Pension with 7% Employer Contribution and 4 x annual salary Life Insurance benefits
Receive a company vehicle for business and personal use
Income growth opportunities as you progress and develop in the role

We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. JOB DESCRIPTION:
Working at Abbott

At Abbott , you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position works remotely for our Core Diagnostics Division.
Qualified candidates must currently live in the territory, preferably near a major airport.
This position will cover our West Region. The ideal base locations for this territory are Texas metros, California metros, Denver, Salt Lake City, Phoenix, or similar markets.
Must be able to travel up to 75%

s.h: Must have a Valid Driver’s License.
s.t:
We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision-making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott ’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments, and informatics systems is often the first step in patient care decision-making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.
What You’ll Work On
The Digital Health Solutions Sales Executive (DHSE) is accountable for business and revenue growth within the designated region/country i ndependent hunting, prospecting, territory buildout, digital-first consulting, and pipeline creation.

DHSE achieves this by providing end-to-end Digital Health Solutions with intelligent insights to enable health care providers, from laboratories to public hospitals to private integrated delivery systems, to achieve revenue targets by improving operational performance and clinical outcomes of existing and new customers.
Major Accountabilities

Acquire new business within assigned district(s), where there is no existing Diagnostics and / or AlinIQ footprint.
Cold outreach, market mapping, and territory penetration, Self-sourced pipeline creation
Set and achieve or exceed quarterly, annual sales quotas and manage sales budgets.
Focus on C-Suite value driver discussions including population/community health, merger and acquisitions, remote patient monitoring, risk stratification of business and patients.
Identify new opportunities for growth by focusing on end-to-end health care improvements as primary value driver for in and outside the lab to pull through digital health solution sales and reagent sales.
Be knowledgeable about industry trends, changing market regulations and healthcare policy within defined customer segment. Understand the impact on customers and their key care-abouts.
Lead and execute complex contract negotiations to achieve the sales quota for given customer base. Create strong territory and strategic account plans to lay out strategic approach and share best practices with larger Sales team to help drive a culture of excellence.
Review account activity, anticipate customer needs and improve customer satisfaction.
Accountable for driving market share growth through new business opportunity realization. The role is instrumental in expanding brand reputation and delivery of sales and profitability objectives.
Research target accounts to understand performance KPIs and customer strategies to drive conversations that demonstrate how the application of IT enablers and service solutions in/outside of the lab and across the broader healthcare space can improve performance KPIs and strategies.
Work collaboratively with sales and DHS counterparts to achieve performance targets and exceed customer expectations.
Navigate within a highly matrixed environment using strong communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate appropriate Abbott resources and support necessary.
Ensures that all activities are performed in compliance with quality system requirements.

Bachelor’s Degree or Associate’s degree with 4 years of sales experience; a focus in healthcare/medical, life sciences, IT or medical technology is preferred
4+ years in sales roles

Experience leading & executing simple to complex (multi stakeholder/multiyear) contract negotiations.
Proven success in hunter roles
Experience opening net-new territories
Strong cold outreach and prospecting discipline
SaaS / Digital Health acquisition experience
Demonstrated ability to align and integrate diverse business teams and functions to ensure they work together to deliver results.
Previous Exposure with IT technology within Health care Environment. Able to articulate customer value propositions at all levels of institutions (e.g., C-Suite) for digital value (e.g., Labor savings, e.g. clinical improvement) leading to successful business closes.
Communication skills and teamwork skills in working with internal / external stakeholders are essential for the role.
Proven ability to influence an effective consultative sales approach to uncover customer pain points and provide value-added solutions in a complex pathology and IT environment
Highly motivated, result driven individual, with strong problem-solving skills and track record of driving measurable outcomes.
Strong ability to pivot and adapt to changing business needs in a fast-pacing high growth environment
Preferred sales experience and knowledge of the Diagnostic environment involving multiple levels of decision makers and the understanding of a complex selling cycle.
Sales or consulting experience with software or digital solution selling preferred.

s.h: Experience in total solution design (TSD) preferred.

Wir denken weiter
Unsere Pensionskassen-Leistungen sind hervorragend.

Unsere externe Vertrauensstelle ist anonym für alle Anliegen unserer Mitarbeitenden da.

Die Stadt Biel lebt von ihrer Vielfalt. Bei uns sind alle Menschen willkommen.

La Ville de Bienne s'engage activement pour l'intégration des personnes d'origine étrangère, en étroite collaboration avec les autorités fédérales et cantonales. Depuis 2019, elle assume la conduite de l'Antenne d'intégration de la région Bienne, Seeland et Jura bernois sur mandat du Canton de Berne.
Dans cette fonction, vous conseillez des personnes et des organisations sur les questions d'intégration et collaborez avec de nombreux partenaires aux niveaux communal, cantonal et national. * Formation supérieure dans le domaine social, juridique ou de l'intégration, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente
* Bonnes connaissances du droit suisse des étrangers et de l'asile
* Excellentes connaissances du français ou de l'allemand et bonnes connaissances de l'autre langue
Idéalement, vous justifiez d'une expérience dans le domaine du conseil en matière de migration, d'intégration, d'affaires sociales ou juridiques. ## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line, is expanding its Talent Acquisition function in support of its continued growth in the US market. We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead hiring for high-impact, business-critical, and leadership-level roles across the organization.

This role requires deep full-cycle recruiting experience, a strong track record of improving recruiting processes, and a thoughtful, data-driven approach to talent strategy.

This person will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders and play a key role in attracting and securing exceptional talent for some of the company-s most important hires. **This role is based within commuting distance of downtown Miami and requires 4 days per week in office.**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for critical roles across the business, including high-profile leadership positions.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior leaders, serving as a trusted Talent Acquisition partner and advisor.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand talent needs, shape job descriptions, and develop effective recruiting strategies. Provide data-driven recommendations on how to attract and assess top talent.
* Use recruiting metrics and analytics to track key performance indicators such as time-to-fill, quality of hire, source of hire, and candidate conversion rates.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR leadership to streamline and optimize hiring processes.
* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to build strong pipelines of qualified candidates. Leverage a mix of traditional and innovative sourcing channels, including social media, job boards, employee referrals, networking, and direct outreach, while using data to refine strategy and improve results.
* Conduct proactive talent mapping, market research, and competitive benchmarking to inform search strategy and stay ahead of industry trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring practices.
* Lead in-depth candidate screening and interview processes to assess qualifications, leadership capabilities, and overall fit.
* Leverage data and feedback to optimize candidate engagement, reduce time-to-hire, and enhance the overall candidate experience.
* Lead the offer process by advising hiring managers on compensation, negotiating complex offers with senior candidates, and ensuring a smooth transition from offer acceptance through onboarding.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and professional experience for candidates throughout the hiring process. Provide timely feedback and keep candidates informed at every stage.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting and/or executive recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for complex, business-critical, and leadership-level roles from manager through SVP.
* Significant in-house recruiting experience within a high-growth, large-scale, or fast-paced environment, with proven success leading searches across functions such as sales, marketing, procurement, IT, and other strategic corporate areas.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage recruiting data and analytics to identify trends, generate insights, and improve hiring outcomes. Strong proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools, with experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruitment analytics platforms.
* Deep experience developing targeted sourcing strategies and engaging high-caliber talent through multiple channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, and direct outreach.
* Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including experience conducting competency-based, behavioral, and situational interviews to evaluate leadership capability, organizational fit, and long-term potential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex insights in a clear and actionable manner, influence senior stakeholders, and represent the company credibly with candidates.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for candidate quality.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems such as SuccessFactors, Workday, or Greenhouse, as well as recruiting analytics platforms such as LinkedIn Talent Insights, Google Analytics, or similar performance-tracking tools.

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
